newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bayerische Landesbank says plans to raise capital.
newsitem.headline: Bayerische Landesbank says plans to raise capital.

text.p: Bayerische Landesbank (BayernLB), the publicly-owned German regional bank for Bavaria, said on Friday it planned to increase its capital by a total of 1.2 billion marks through annual increases of 300 million marks in the years 1998 through 2002.
The measure will almost double the bank's capital, which currently totals 1.3 billion marks, chief executive Franz Neubauer told a news conference late on Thursday.
The bank is owned by the state of Bavaria and by the state's savings bank association.
Neubauer said the state had already signalled its approval of the capital increase and that he expected the savings banks to agree to the move as well.
Neubauer said the bank had agreed to pay its owners a dividend of seven percent after tax for the four-year period.
The capital rise was aimed at replenishing the bank's reserves and gaining funds to expand, Neubauer said.
